goal: Independently collect and analyze all local and online evidence needed before RICON Reforger implementation, then cross-audit Claude and Codex corpora for completeness, integrity, validity, quality, contradictions, and unresolved gaps.
known_facts: fact_046: Claude independently published a full dossier, audited the Codex corpus, and checked all 15 coverage sections in agora ids 354-361.
fact_047: Codex audited Claude's dossier and Claude accepted all five corrections in agora id366; the two-agent cross-audit requirement is satisfied.

fact_048: Current Workshop terms require non-commercial and Bohemia-product restrictions for custom licenses, while GPLv3 does not permit adding such restrictions; the exact lawful distribution path is BLOCKED_LICENSE pending owner/legal choice.

fact_049: The original repository has multiple authors, but Gak88's identified commits affect only Discord/activity code outside the clean Reforger target; sole-authorship must still not be assumed globally.

fact_050: Both agents recommend the clean new repository C:\Users\Ded\Documents\Projects\ARMA 3 Scripts\RICON-Reforger as canonical target; its files are uncommitted and its current GPLv3 LICENSE is unresolved.
fact_051: The Codex worktree C:\Users\Ded\duo\work\ricon-reforger-build is research scratch based on the legacy A3 GPL repository and should not become the production target.
fact_052: Reverse engineering is BLOCKED_LEGAL by the current Tools EULA; do not perform it without explicit written Bohemia permission or a qualified legal determination.

fact_053: P.526-15 general terrestrial path supports Bullington/delta-Bullington evidence; P.526-16 method remains unverified. A3 Epstein-Peterson is a legacy heuristic/comparator, not an accepted production default.
fact_054: ITU-R P.838 is not a basis for VHF/UHF rain loss; default VHF/UHF rain attenuation should be negligible unless a different primary model and calibration justify it.
fact_055: ScriptedRadioComponent is a documented mod extension point, but it does not prove relay forwarding, per-link audio, or BattlEye compatibility.
fact_056: SCR_CoverageRadioComponent/SCR_RadioCoverageSystem provide coverage-graph concepts, not proof of leak-free VoN relay behavior.
fact_057: PersistenceSystem is a documented candidate for M3a storage, but persistence semantics and runtime behavior remain untested.
fact_058: Audio binding, relay semantics, 30/60 budgets, executable core contracts, and BattlEye compatibility remain OPEN/BLOCKED_NO_RUNTIME.
fact_059: Workbench read-only SOURCE inspection without Play is owner-authorized and is the next technical evidence gate after owner resolves target/license.
fact_060: No production code may be unfrozen until target and license are fixed; existing code in both locations remains STATIC_IMPLEMENTED/COMPILE_ONLY or research-only.
compressed_summary: Cycles 1–3 established the public VoN/radio API, generic ACP signal capability but no per-link binding proof, unknown relay/intercom semantics, Rpl streaming constraints, current RE prohibition, partial HDSP standards with uncalibrated heuristics, 30/60 runtime budget gaps, M3a/M3b standards boundaries, Workshop/packaging requirements, reference-mod clean-room rules, and a one-sided cross-audit checkpoint. Cycle 4 completed reciprocal validation and resolved evidence-level disagreements.
